RollMode.Name: ACDC roll mode
RollMode.Hint: Choose whether ACDC sets dice fulfillment to automatic, native manual, or smart routing.

ManualRollTypes.Name: Smart routing roll types
ManualRollTypes.Hint: Select roll types to resolve manually while other roll types roll automatically. If none are selected, ACDC toggles all rolls between automatic and manual.

ManualNonRegisteredDenominations.Name: Include non-registered denominations
ManualNonRegisteredDenominations.Hint: Include denominations not registered in Foundry's dice fulfillment settings, such as 1d7, in manual or smart-routed rolls.
